decision: The competitor (McLaren F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
event_name: Document 40 Date 03 September 2022 Time 17:25 2022 DUTCH GRAND PRIX 01 - 04 September 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (Documents 36 & 37) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 34.14 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 4 (Lando Norris), the driver of Car 22 (Yuki Tsunoda) and team representatives, examined video evidence and determined that the team released Car 4 into the path of Car 22, as a result of which TSU had to brake to avoid a collision.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 4 Unsafe Release
